mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, icon, home_path, sort_order, status, built_in, create_time, last_modify_time FROM sys_app WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT product AS product, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sys_permission WHERE product IS NOT NULL AND product <> '' GROUP BY product
SELECT product AS product, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sys_menu WHERE product IS NOT NULL AND product <> '' AND menu_type IN ('DIR', 'MENU') GROUP BY product
